fact: A national crop type map for the 2024 summer season (monitoring window 15 November 2023 to 15 July 2024) was produced from Sentinel-2 imagery with the Sen4Stat toolbox under FAO-EOSTAT, with 77 percent overall accuracy, using data from the Ministry of Lands, Agriculture, Fisheries, Water and Rural Development.
title: UN Handbook on Remote Sensing for Agricultural Statistics - 14 Crop Classification in Zimbabwe
why_not: the document carries no date of its own
